احتقرنا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَقَرْنَا (iḥtaqarnā) /iħ.ta.qar.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
# اُحْتُقِرْنَا (uḥtuqirnā) /uħ.tu.qir.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِحْتَقَرَ (iḥtaqara)
